capabilities: Highlight selected text in reading mode with == markers
Browse a note's highlights in a sidebar panel
Edit, copy, remove, or undo highlights
Copy selected text from a selection toolbar
disambiguation: Only works in reading mode; it cannot create highlights while editing in Live Preview or source mode.
extras: Originally created by Tintalectronico and now maintained by keithwithAI; the manifest notes the plugin has not been reviewed by Obsidian staff.
intentEvidence: Highlight selected text in Obsidian's reading mode using ==markdown highlight== syntax.
problem: Obsidian's highlight syntax can only be typed while editing, so text cannot be highlighted from reading mode, especially on mobile.
summary: Reading-mode highlighter that wraps selected text in ==highlight== syntax and stores optional highlight notes as footnotes.
